name: Changed Heart
overview: Scripture reveals that the human heart is inherently deceitful and desperately wicked, requiring divine intervention for true transformation. God promises to replace the stony heart with a heart of flesh, granting a clean and renewed spirit that desires to know Him fully. Believers are called to guard their hearts diligently, recognizing that life flows from it, and as they delight in the Lord, He aligns their desires with His will. This changed heart leads to a restored relationship with God, marked by wholehearted devotion and intimate knowledge of Him.
